name: Gunship Global Operations
storyline: The world order is on the brink of collapse. A shadow paramilitary force rises under the command of Dimitri Vaskov. His most lethal weapon: a virus that turns soldiers and civilians into the living dead. You are an elite operator of the Shadow Task Force. Your mission: track Vaskov, stop the virus's spread, and dismantle the dark plan known as the Zmey Protocol. From abandoned military complexes to hidden mountain laboratories, you will face both enemy forces and hordes of the infected. Every decision shapes humanity's fate. The Zmey Protocol has begun. Survival is not enough; you must destroy the threat.
summary: Take command of the Gunship and rain fire from above! Use powerful weapons, real thermal vision, defend against enemies and support allied forces to dominate missions and change the course of battle.
